say:3:1360003001:1.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯大人，我们回来啦！

say:4:1360003002:1.text: Phew, Chippy thought we cleared out most of the golems, but it looks like there were still plenty left to keep us on our toes.
say:4:1360003002:1.source_cn: 呼，原本以为魔偶已经被消灭得差不多了，没想到还有不少呢。

say:6:1360003003:0.text: I'm back too! I couldn't let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> do all the work, so I grabbed as many shell parts as I could find.
say:6:1360003003:0.male: I'm back too! I couldn't let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> do all the work, so I grabbed as many shell parts as I could find.
say:6:1360003003:0.female: I'm back too! I couldn't let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> do all the work, so I grabbed as many shell parts as I could find.

say:7:1360003004:1.text: Nice work, everyone! Now the area around the temple should finally be at peace.
say:7:1360003004:1.source_cn: 噢，干得不错，各位，这样一来神殿周围也能清净点了。

say:8:1360003005:1.text: Archon Dionel?! Don't tell me you sent us out there just to deal with the golems for you!
say:8:1360003005:1.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯大人？！你该不会是把我们当成驱逐魔偶的苦力了吧！

say:9:1360003006:1.text: Haha, well... maybe just a little. But that was just a bonus. The real treasure lies in the parts you've collected.
say:9:1360003006:1.source_cn: 哈哈，当然也有一点点这方面原因，不过那只是顺带的，最重...

say:10:1360003007:1.text: Actually, <style="highlight">during this time of year</style>, these particular golem parts can fetch quite the price from the <style="highlight">dwarves</style>.

say:11:1360003008:1.text: The coins you'll make from selling them will help fund a grand festival in the nearby villages—far more rewarding than chasing after those elusive lucky satchels, don't you think?
say:11:1360003008:1.source_cn: 有了这笔钱，附近的村落想必能度过足够华丽和热闹的春焰庆...

say:12:1360003009:1.text: That's all from me! My guidance ends here.
say:12:1360003009:1.source_cn: 话也说得够多了，我的引导就到此为止。

say:13:1360003010:0.text: I'm off to enjoy some well-earned peace and quiet. Best of luck to you all!
say:13:1360003010:0.source_cn: 该回去继续享受难得的清静了，祝你们一切顺利！

say:16:1360003011:0.text: ...Peace and quiet, huh? Feels more like he just used us to handle his golem problem.
say:16:1360003011:0.source_cn: ……说什么“难得的清静”，我看他就是在借我们的手清理周...

say:17:1360003012:1.text: Hah! Even a Celestial can't resist passing off their chores. Turns out these "lofty beings" aren't so different after all.
say:17:1360003012:1.source_cn: 哈，堂堂半神，竟然也会借人之手的路数，他们这些高高在上...

say:18:1360003013:1.text: Hmm, but he's not wrong. Selling these parts to the dwarves during this time of year is bound to turn a profit...
say:18:1360003013:1.source_cn: 唔，按半神大人的提示，最近这段时间把零件卖给矮人就能获...

choice_prompt:19:1360003013.text: Hmm, but he's not wrong. Selling these parts to the dwarves during this time of year is bound to turn a profit...
choice_prompt:19:1360003013.source_cn: 唔，按半神大人的提示，最近这段时间把零件卖给矮人就能获利颇丰……

say:20:1360003014:1.text: The Emberlight Festival, the dwarves' trade habits... it all lines up. The timing's perfect!
say:20:1360003014:1.source_cn: 最近，春焰庆……矮人，啊，我知道了，原来如此！

say:21:1360003016:1.text: Don't worry about the details, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That Celestial's advice is solid. Find a dwarf and you'll see for yourself.
say:21:1360003016:1.male: Don't worry about the details, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That Celestial's advice is solid. Find a dwarf and you'll see for yourself.
say:21:1360003016:1.female: Don't worry about the details, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That Celestial's advice is solid. Find a dwarf and you'll see for yourself.

say:22:1360003017:1.text: Why? Are they using these parts for the festival?
say:22:1360003017:1.source_cn: 为什么，阿塔兰忒？这段时间矮人会收购零件吗？为了过节？

say:23:1360003018:1.text: Let's just say... you'll understand when you <style="highlight">meet one</style>. Explaining is too much work!

say:24:1360003019:1.text: Less talking, more action! Hunting for lucky satchels is way more exciting than selling boring old parts. I'm off!
say:24:1360003019:1.source_cn: 多说不如多做！比起倒卖那些无聊的零件，还是紧张刺激的狩...

say:25:1360003020:1.text: Good luck with your next tasks!
say:25:1360003020:1.source_cn: 祝我好运，也祝你们一切顺利！

say:26:1360003021:1.text: Before you can say anything, Atalanta vanishes, leaving the group staring after her.
say:26:1360003021:1.source_cn: 还没来得及回答，阿塔兰忒已经潇洒地消失在了视线当中，只...
say:26:1360003021:1.male: Before you can say anything, Atalanta vanishes, leaving the group staring after her.
say:26:1360003021:1.female: Before you can say anything, Atalanta vanishes, leaving the group staring after her.

say:27:1360003022:1.text: So... what should we do with these parts? The dwarves haven't visited in months...
say:27:1360003022:1.source_cn: 那，这些零件怎么办呢……以前倒是有矮人来村里收购过东西...

say:28:1360003023:1.text: I still have to take care of my younger siblings, so I can't leave right now...
say:28:1360003023:1.source_cn: 我还得照顾弟弟妹妹，现在走不开……

say:29:1360003024:1.text: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?
say:29:1360003024:1.source_cn: 矮人……我们不就认识一位矮人吗，主人！
say:29:1360003024:1.male: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?
say:29:1360003024:1.female: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?

choice_prompt:30:1360003024.text: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?
choice_prompt:30:1360003024.source_cn: 矮人……我们不就认识一位矮人吗，主人！
choice_prompt:30:1360003024.male: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?
choice_prompt:30:1360003024.female: Dwarves... don't we know one, Magister?

say:32:1360003025:0.text: But we don't know any other dwarves!
say:32:1360003025:0.source_cn: 但是其他矮人我们也不熟呀！
say:32:1360003025:0.male: But we don't know any other dwarves!
say:32:1360003025:0.female: But we don't know any other dwarves!

say:33:1360003026:0.text: That's right! We can sell these parts to Hugin and give the money to Marilee—everyone wins!
say:33:1360003026:0.source_cn: 没错！我们带着这些零件卖给呼金，最后把获利交给梅瑞特，...
say:33:1360003026:0.male: That's right! We can sell these parts to Hugin and give the money to Marilee—everyone wins!
say:33:1360003026:0.female: That's right! We can sell these parts to Hugin and give the money to Marilee—everyone wins!

say:34:1360003027:1.text: Hugin has good connections with the dwarves and knows all the local customs. Plus, he might even share some cool stories about the origins of the Emberlight Festival!
say:34:1360003027:1.source_cn: 呼金在矮人中很有人脉，而且他很懂各地的习俗，说不定还能...

choice_prompt:35:1360003027.text: Hugin has good connections with the dwarves and knows all the local customs. Plus, he might even share some cool stories about the origins of the Emberlight Festival!
choice_prompt:35:1360003027.source_cn: 呼金在矮人中很有人脉，而且他很懂各地的习俗，说不定还能给我们好好讲讲春焰庆的由来呢！

say:36:1360003028:1.text: Oh, please don't feel pressured! I only need a bit to buy gifts for my siblings, but I'm sure I can make do somehow...
say:36:1360003028:1.source_cn: 当然了！毕竟大部分零件都是你们带回来的，我只要自己的那...

say:37:1360003029:0.text: Aw, don't worry, Marilee! Leave these parts to us. We know the perfect buyer! Once we sell them, we'll bring the money straight back to you.
say:37:1360003029:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特，这些零件和材料就交给我们吧，我们有一位很合适的...

say:38:1360003030:1.text: Thank you so much! I genuinely appreciate it. After you're done, feel free to stop by anytime!
say:38:1360003030:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！我就不多客气了，等你们忙完了，随时来我家做客！

choice:35:0:1.text: I can't keep the money for myself?
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 不是，钱我就不能自己留着吗？
choice:35:0:1.male: I can't keep the money for myself?
choice:35:0:1.female: I can't keep the money for myself?

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 讲道理，我觉得最近见他太频繁了

say:41:1360003015:1.text: Dwarves... the Emberlight Festival... ah, now I get it!
say:41:1360003015:1.source_cn: 矮人，好价钱，还是春焰庆期间……啊，我明白了，怪不得！

choice:19:1:2.text: Why do the dwarves want these?
choice:19:1:2.male: Why do the dwarves want these?
choice:19:1:2.female: Why do the dwarves want these?
